---
name: GitHub changed an achievement
about: A threshold, tier or rule seems different from what the tool uses
title: "[Tiers] "
labels: tiers
---

**Achievement**

For example: Pull Shark, Pair Extraordinaire, Galaxy Brain, Starstruck, Quickdraw, YOLO or Public Sponsor.

**What the tool says vs. what GitHub shows**

For example: "the tool says x2 needs 16 merged PRs, but my badge turned x2 at 20".

**Evidence**

Links help the most: your achievement page (`https://github.com/<you>?tab=achievements`), a GitHub changelog or docs page, or a community discussion. Please include the date you noticed it.

**Output of `gh-achievements why <you> <achievement>`** (optional, no tokens)

```text

```
